name: downloadActivityFit
description:
Download the ORIGINAL .FIT file of an activity and save it on the user's computer.
Returns the absolute path of the saved .fit file (second-by-second HR, cadence, speed, laps).

name: editDashboard
description:
Changes the layout, the custom widgets or the languages of the dashboard page (a page from the
template; call writeDashboard first). Without arguments it only reads: the reply has the layout, the
custom widgets, the missing texts of each language, the catalogue of built-in widgets and `widgetApi`,
the guide to writing a custom widget. `layout` replaces the whole layout (the text of the page's
'Copy layout'); `place` adds widgets at the end of a board; `widgets` adds or replaces custom widgets
by id and saves them in the widget library (<data-dir>/widgets.json), which every page from the
template gets; `removeWidgets` removes them from this page and its boards, `forgetWidgets` also
from the library. `widgetTexts` adds texts to custom widgets by id, language and key, e.g.
{"longest-ride": {"de": {"title": "Längste Fahrt"}}}. `languages` adds page texts by key, e.g.
{"de": {"title": "Training + Erholung"}}: keys and {placeholders} as in `englishTexts: true`; a
text with "|" has a singular and a plural form. Missing texts show in English.
`removeLanguages` removes languages that `languages` added.

layout.description: A whole layout: { base, boards: { all: [{ id, widget, type?, span, hidden? }] } }

board.description: all, recovery, running, strengthTraining, walking, hiking, cycling, swimming, racket, generic (Other), or another SDK sport name

widget.description: A widget id of the catalogue or a custom widget

type.description: The type the widget shows, when not the board's

code.description: The body of a function (el, ctx): see widgetApi

texts.description: Texts by language code and key; title is the title: see widgetApi

removeWidgets.description: Ids of custom widgets to remove from this page

forgetWidgets.description: Ids of custom widgets to remove from the library and from this page

widgetTexts.description: Texts of custom widgets by widget id, language code and key

languages.description: Texts by language code and key

removeLanguages.description: Codes of added languages, e.g. de

englishTexts.description: Also return the English texts to translate

path.description: The .html file; relative paths are inside the data dir

name: garminGet
description:
Generic read-only GET on the Garmin Connect Personal API, for endpoints not covered by the
other tools or when a query parameter name has to be adjusted. 'path' is relative and starts
with '/', e.g. /fitnessage-service/fitnessage/v2/2026-10-25 . 'query' is an optional
URL query string without '?', e.g. date=2026-10-25&foo=bar .

name: getActivity
description: Get the full detail of one activity (summary, metadata, splits/laps) as JSON.

name: getActivityLaps
description:
Laps of an activity as recorded by the watch (manual laps, auto-lap every km, or workout
steps), read from the original .FIT file. One row per lap: distance (km), timer time,
pace (min/km, foot sports) or speed (km/h), average/max HR, cadence (spm for running),
ascent/descent, average power, intensity (active/rest/warmup/cooldown) and lap trigger.
Use it for intervals and per-km splits; getActivity does not have them.

name: getActivitySets
description:
Strength training sets of an activity, read from the original .FIT file. One entry per
exercise, in the order first done, with its movement category, its primary and secondary
muscles (from Garmin's exercise catalogue) and its active sets: reps,
weight (kg, absent when none was recorded), set time in seconds and the rest after the set
(restSec). Exercise names are stable across sessions, so they can be used for per-exercise
trends. Edits made later in Garmin Connect (renamed exercises, corrected reps or weights)
are not in the .FIT file.

name: getActivityWorkouts
description:
The planned workout that an activity followed, as created in Garmin Connect: its steps in
order, each with its intensity (warmup/active/rest/recovery/cooldown), its duration (time in
seconds, reps, or open), its target (cadence, heart rate, pace, or open, with low and high
values), the exercise for strength steps, and the coach's notes. A step with durationType
REPEAT_UNTIL_STEPS_CMPLT repeats the steps from stepIndex durationValue up to it, targetValue
times in all. Compare it with getActivitySets or getActivityLaps for plan against done.
An empty list means the activity followed no planned workout. Null fields are left out.

name: getBodyBattery
description:
Body Battery for up to 14 days, yyyy-MM-dd: for each day how much it charged and drained,
its readings through the day, and the events that changed it (sleep, activities, stress,
naps) with their impact.

name: getDailyHeartRate
description: Daily heart rate for one date (includes resting heart rate), yyyy-MM-dd.

name: getDailySummary
description: Daily user summary (steps, calories, stress, body battery, resting HR) for one date, or for up to 14 days (fromDate and toDate; the range answer has Garmin's v2 field names), yyyy-MM-dd.

name: getDashboardData
description:
All the data of the training dashboard in one call: HR zones, fitness age, the activities of the
last `weeks` weeks (compact summaries, with strength sets and laps where they apply), the activities
of the weeks before for the period comparison, daily HRV, and the last 14 days of sleep and daily
summaries, and `units`: the measurement system of the Garmin profile (metric, statute_us or
statute_uk) that the page shows; the data itself is always metric; `locale`: the language of
the Garmin profile, e.g. it or pt-BR. Keeps a local cache and
fetches from Garmin only what is new since the last call, so a rebuild or an update needs few
calls. `sync` in the result says what was fetched.

name: getFitnessAge
description:
Garmin fitness age for a date, yyyy-MM-dd: fitness age vs chronological age, the achievable
fitness age, and its components (body fat, vigorous days and minutes per week, resting HR)
with the targets Garmin suggests.

name: getHeartRateZones
description: Heart rate zones currently configured in Garmin Connect.

name: getHrvRange
description: Daily HRV (overnight) summaries for a date range, yyyy-MM-dd.

name: getSleep
description: Sleep data for one night (date: the morning you woke up), or for up to 14 nights (fromDate and toDate), yyyy-MM-dd.

name: getWeight
description:
Weight for a date range, yyyy-MM-dd: the latest weight of each day (with body fat, muscle
and bone mass, BMI and body water when a scale records them), the average of the range, and
the last weight before and the first after the range. Set includeAll=true for every entry
of each day. Weight, muscle mass and bone mass are in grams.

includeAll.description: Every weight entry of each day, not only the latest

name: listActivities
description:
List the user's Garmin activities (most recent first) as a compact summary: id, name, type,
local start time, distance (km), moving duration, average pace, average/max heart rate,
cadence, ascent; when Garmin has them: elapsed time (if longer than moving time), race flag,
Garmin training load, aerobic/anaerobic training effect and label, seconds in HR zones 1-5,
calories, moderate/vigorous intensity minutes, body battery change, steps, swim SWOLF, pool
length, lengths and strokes, power, running form (stride, ground contact, vertical
oscillation and ratio), grade-adjusted pace, best efforts (1k, mile, 5k, 10k, half,
marathon) and run/walk segments. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd. Set raw=true for Garmin's full JSON.

activityType.description: Activity type key (optional): a parent type such as running or cycling, or a subtype such as trail_running

raw.description: Return Garmin's raw JSON instead of the summary

names.description: Activity names (optional): keep only the activities whose name contains one of them, ignoring case

name: writeDashboard
description:
Writes the training dashboard page (default <data-dir>/garmin-dashboard.html) with the data of the
last `weeks` weeks, and returns its path and a short digest of the data (totals, weekly sums, load,
best efforts, races, strength top sets, HRV, recovery, fitness age, sync) for the coach notes.
An existing page keeps all its code, layout and widgets: only its data is replaced. A page from an
older template gets the new template and keeps its layout and widgets. Every page from the template
also gets the custom widgets of the widget library (<data-dir>/widgets.json), not placed on a board.
`layout` writes a new page
from the template: `preset` (the default widgets) or `blank` (empty boards). `page` writes your own
page code instead; it must contain /* garmin-data:start */null/* garmin-data:end */. A replaced
page is kept as <file>.bak. `notes`: at most 5 plain-text coach notes; the server escapes them.
`settings` replace the page's settings (title, headline, sports, data to leave out, languages,
themes); without them the page keeps its own. The page holds only the data, languages and themes
they keep. `pageLanguages` in the result lists the languages of the page's Language menu, and
`settings` the settings that the page keeps. `missingProfileLanguage` is the language of the Garmin
profile when the page has no texts in it (it shows English); editDashboard `languages` adds it.
`missingWidgetTexts` lists the custom widgets that miss texts in a language of the page, with
those languages; editDashboard `widgetTexts` adds them.
`preview: true` writes nothing: it returns the digest and the activities of each board.

notes.description: Coach notes, plain text; without notes the page has none

layout.description: Write a new page from the template with this layout

page.description: Your own page code, with an empty garmin-data block, instead of the template

path.description: The .html file; relative paths are inside the data dir

title.description: Replaces the title in every language

sports.description: The boards to keep, e.g. running, cycling; all when not set

exclude.description: The data to leave out of the page

languages.description: Languages to keep: en, it, de, fr, es, pt; when not set, English and the language of the Garmin profile

language.description: Default language: auto or a code

themes.description: Themes to keep: system, midnight, graphite, ocean, forest, plum, light, paper, mist, hcDark, hcLight

settings.description: The page settings; replaces the page's own

preview.description: Write nothing: return the digest and the activities of each board
